lines.en: Two claws trot along the path

lines.zh: 我走两步就停一下，像在啄食
lines.en: I take two steps and pause, as if pecking
Chickens bob their heads, so do I

lines.zh: 羽毛下面，动作太连贯了
lines.en: Under the feathers, the movement is too smooth
I cross the yard sideways
There are worms on the ground, I do not look

lines.zh: 我绕开别的鸡，走得更直
lines.en: I go around the other chickens, straighter

lines.zh: 我这一身白毛，很容易脏
lines.en: This white plumage dirties easily

lines.zh: 每一步都落在同一块石头上
lines.en: Every step lands on the same stone

lines.zh: 我拍拍翅膀，其实不太会飞
lines.en: I flap my wings, though I cannot really fly

lines.zh: 鸡群在前头，我跟在后头
lines.en: The flock is ahead, I am behind

lines.zh: 我走得比鸡慢一点，好装
lines.en: A little slower than a chicken, better to blend

lines.zh: 我在晒谷场上跑，沙子飞起来
lines.en: I run on the drying floor and sand flies up
My claws slip on the flagstones
I walk in the shade along the wall

lines.zh: 我抬腿的姿势，练了很多次
lines.en: I have practiced that leg lift many times
I crouch on the straw pile, a convincing act
My claws are tucked under my body

lines.zh: 我歪头看地，什么都没看
lines.en: I tilt my head at the ground and see nothing
Chickens cluck, I do not

lines.zh: 羽毛有点松，风一吹就翘
lines.en: Some feathers are loose, a breeze lifts them

lines.zh: 我这一身，只有四点生命那么轻
lines.en: In this body I am only four points of life
The others peck dirt, I listen
A shadow passed on the ground, I did not move

lines.zh: 我低头，脖子弯得很不自然
lines.en: I lower my head, the neck bends unnaturally
I have crouched a long while, my legs are stiff
This yard is only so big

lines.zh: 我在等一个没人注意的时机
lines.en: I am waiting for a moment nobody is watching
I preen the feathers on my chest

lines.zh: 一只鸡来啄我，我躲开了
lines.en: A chicken pecked at me and I dodged
I crouch on the doorstep watching the yard

lines.zh: 这身羽毛在风里散开一点
lines.en: The feathers part a little in the wind
You looked down at the chickens and found me
My head is tilted, my eyes are not
Do you have grain in that hand

lines.zh: 我这么小，你一脚就能踩死
lines.en: I am this small, one step could kill me
I edge closer to your feet
There is mud on your shoe, yard mud
Do not kick, I have not figured you out
I flap my wings once

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就跑不了了
lines.en: If you crouch, I will have nowhere to go

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我盯着你的手
lines.en: While you smile, I watch your hands

lines.zh: 我这张鸡脸，什么都看不出来
lines.en: This chicken face shows nothing
You turn to leave, and I follow
Feathers went everywhere
I am over and my claws are kicking

lines.zh: 这一下，我半边身子都麻了
lines.en: Half my body went numb
I stumbled two steps

lines.zh: 我这么轻，挨一下就飞出去
lines.en: So light, one hit sends me flying
I keep my head down and act fine
My wing is wrong, I cannot fly
Four points of life is far too little
I do not call out, I endure it

lines.zh: 你这一脚，差点把我送走
lines.en: That kick nearly finished me
Grain? I pecked at it twice
Chickens eat this, so do I
I pecked a while and got nothing

lines.zh: 你撒在地上的，我记住了位置
lines.en: I have noted where you scattered it

lines.zh: 这么多谷子，够一个院子吃
lines.en: So much grain would feed the whole yard
I snatched one and ran off
The other chickens have all come over
Lower your hand a little more
I eat, but I am not that hungry

lines.zh: 你要是蹲着不走，我就一直啄
lines.en: If you keep crouching there, I will keep pecking

lines.zh: 你手心里的谷子，我看了半天
lines.en: I studied the grain in your palm a long while

lines.zh: 我啄了你的指头，不是故意的
lines.en: I pecked your finger, not on purpose

lines.zh: 先给那只芦花的，它吃得快
lines.en: Give it to the speckled one, she eats fast
Scattered on the ground, slow to pick up

lines.zh: 我仰着头，装成讨食的样子
lines.en: I tilt my head up and beg like a chicken

lines.zh: 谷子壳卡在嘴里，我甩了甩
lines.en: A husk stuck in my beak, I shook it loose
One touch and I topple over
I flap myself upright
You are so heavy, I am only a chicken
That rolled me twice
I backed to the wall and could not dodge
You stepped on my claw
I walk away crooked, playing hurt
Do not come down on me from above

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就不是鸡了
lines.en: One more and I stop being a chicken

lines.zh: 院子里公鸡很多，我不是
lines.en: There are roosters in this yard, I am not one
These chickens circle me all day
These feathers are borrowed

lines.zh: 这院子里的规矩，我不懂
lines.en: I do not understand the rules of this yard

lines.zh: 你要看孵蛋，那里有一窝
lines.en: If you want to see hatching, there is a nest
I cannot even crow

lines.zh: 凑过来之前，想想我有几点生命
lines.en: Before you come close, remember how little life I have
The ground is filthy, do not crouch
They are them, and I am me
Walk away, someone will see
I pecked at it and could not lift it
Claws cannot grip
I kick it against the wall

lines.zh: 这么小一粒，我一口一个
lines.en: A grain this small, I take it one by one

lines.zh: 地上有的是，不差这一个
lines.en: There is plenty on the ground, one more does not matter
I carried it two steps and dropped it
Another chicken saw it first

lines.zh: 它滚到我脚边，我踩住了
lines.en: It rolled to my foot and I pinned it
If you pick it up, I watch first
In the grass, it is lost
I have fixed on your feet
I have shifted two steps your way
There is nobody else in the yard
I flapped my wings once
The other chickens have scattered
This body is too light, I must get close

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我就在后面
lines.en: When you turn, I am right behind

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫一声就暴露了
lines.en: I do not call, one call would give me away
Even with four points of life, I can bite

lines.zh: 你的脚踝就在我嘴边高度
lines.en: Your ankle is right at the height of my beak
I follow low along the ground, silently
When you stop, I peck
I run a little faster than a chicken
The yard is small, you cannot turn freely
I have slipped in behind you
When you lift a foot, I dodge
Half of me fits in the straw

lines.zh: 你听见地上有爪子声吗
lines.en: Do you hear claws on the ground

lines.zh: 我一向不叫，这是我的好处
lines.en: I never call, that is my advantage
Two more steps and you are in the corner
I leap and peck once
Light, but accurate
My claws rake your foot

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，自己先翻了
lines.en: I hit your leg and toppled first
This bite found its spot
A wing beats your hand
You lift a foot, I slip aside
Four points of life, and it still lunges

lines.zh: 你摸到的地方，会有个红点
lines.en: Where you touch, there will be a red mark
I am not the one panicking
One more in the flock
I come around from behind the haystack
A line of small claw prints has appeared

lines.zh: 别的鸡都抬头看了一眼
lines.en: The other chickens glanced up once
These feathers are still new

lines.zh: 我落在院子中间，正合适
lines.en: I land in the middle of the yard, just right
I stop by the feed bowl
Dust settles on the husks
I lower my head along with them

lines.zh: 这个院子有多余的位置
lines.en: This yard has room for one more
The feathers curled in fire, a foul smell

lines.zh: 我从草垛上掉下来，摔得直转
lines.en: I fell off the haystack and spun
My feathers soaked and I sank
The blast threw me against the wall

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过院子，擦到我
lines.en: An arrow crossed the yard and grazed me

lines.zh: 那股力气让我缩成一团
lines.en: That force made me curl up

lines.zh: 地上什么也没有，我饿得直晃
lines.en: Nothing on the ground, hunger makes me stagger

lines.zh: 雷一响，整院子鸡都炸了
lines.en: At the thunder, the whole yard of chickens burst apart

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我扑腾不起来
lines.en: No ground below, my wings cannot lift me
